question: Which of the following aqueous solutions exhibits the highest boiling point?
explanation: AlCl<sub>3</sub> produces 4 ions (i = 4), yielding the highest particle concentration and maximum boiling point elevation.
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जलीय विलयन उच्चतम क्वथनांक (boiling point) प्रदर्शित करता है?

question: The depression in freezing point of a solvent is directly proportional to:
explanation: ΔT<sub>f</sub> = K<sub>f</sub> · m, showing direct proportionality to molality.
question_hi: विलायक के हिमांक में अवनमन (depression in freezing point) सीधे किसके समानुपाती होता है?
explanation_hi: ΔT<sub>f</sub> = K<sub>f</sub> · m, जो मोललता के साथ सीधी समानुपाती संबंध को दर्शाता है।

question: If the freezing point of an aqueous solution is -0.186 °C, what is the molality of the solution? (K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86 K kg mol<sup>-1</sup>)
